entries.f08d2de9fba8857c: The core of its management strategy is a dominant strategy concentrating development in the Jōnan and Jōsai areas, which are popular even within Tokyo's 23 wards. It has built a vertically integrated model that handles everything from land acquisition through planning and design, construction, sales, management and repairs, and says that through a horizontal expansion strategy of rolling this business model out to other regions and fields, it aims to stabilize earnings and expand growth opportunities. In the Real Estate Development Business it is expanding its network of domestic and overseas investors, in the Real Estate Rental Business it is providing management services using AI and IT, and in the Construction Business it is increasing orders for non-residential projects and renewal work.
